page.overview:
Who is Assault Mercenary?

Assault Mercenary, known as Buster Mercenary in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Assault Mercenary". He appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator.

Assault Mercenary uses an "/Assault Mode" Deck titled, "Slash All".
